summary: Bandırma Airport (BDM/LTBG) serves the coastal city of Bandırma in Balıkesir Province, northwestern Turkey, situated on the southern shore of the Sea of Marmara. The airport supports both civilian and military operations and primarily handles domestic flights, serving as a gateway to the Marmara region and providing access to nearby ferry connections toward Istanbul. Its relatively small footprint makes it a convenient point of entry for travelers heading to Bandırma's port and surrounding industrial and agricultural areas.
faqs:
Q: How far is Bandırma Airport from the city center?
A: The airport is located approximately 7-8 kilometers northeast of central Bandırma, typically a 15-20 minute drive depending on traffic.

Q: Does Bandırma Airport offer international flights?
A: The airport primarily handles domestic flights within Turkey, with occasional seasonal or charter services. International travelers typically connect through Istanbul or other major hubs.

Q: Are there car rental services available at the airport?
A: Yes, several local car rental agencies operate at or near the airport, providing vehicles for exploring the Marmara region.

Q: Can I catch a ferry to Istanbul from Bandırma?
A: Yes, Bandırma has a major ferry terminal offering regular car and passenger ferry services to Istanbul (Yenikapı) and other destinations across the Sea of Marmara.
transport_tips: The most convenient way to reach the city center from Bandırma Airport is by taxi, which is readily available outside the terminal and offers a quick 15-minute ride. Public minibuses (dolmuş) also serve routes between the airport and central Bandırma at affordable rates. If you plan to continue to Istanbul, consider taking a short taxi ride to the Bandırma ferry terminal for high-speed ferry connections.
local_tip: If you have a few hours to spare before your flight, visit the nearby Bandırma ferry terminal area for fresh seafood at waterfront restaurants—it's a favorite among locals and offers a true taste of the Marmara coast.
